ops-bot: INCIDENT P1 detected — High tail latency for inference pool (us-east-1). Pager: pages duty -> maya (oncall). See incident console: https://redwood.example/incident/INC-2026-1345 :rotating_light:

maya (oncall): taking the sundown shift. I see the P1 active. Anyone able to drive? need driver + comms owner. status: errors spiking ~300ms p95 -> 1.2s p99 on model-serving nodes.

luke: I can drive. jumping in — will start checkpointing traces and head into the runtime logs.

maya (oncall): thanks @luke. samir, can you be comms? you're on rotation for evening.

samir: on it. I'll own customer comms and updates, loop in product-safety if needed. I'll post an initial customer note in 10m unless we resolve.

luke: quick notes — looks like KV-cache pressure on the 4xA100 nodes. I'm seeing elevated GC and occasional OOM-ish eviction logs. grabbing logs:

```
2026-06-12T01:03:15Z runtime[svc-serve-12]: kvcache_eviction_count=1234 seq=98765 free_mem_mb=210
2026-06-12T01:03:31Z runtime[svc-serve-12]: attach_kv_shard failed: ENOMEM, fallback to cold load
2026-06-12T01:04:02Z router[ingress]: response_ms p99=1210 p95=320 throughput=145r/s
```

luke: following runbook snippet for cache pressure mitigation -> rolling bump of kv-cache size on a subset and scale up pool if needed. runbook: https://redwood.example/runbooks/inference-cache-pressure

maya (oncall): call out coverage gap: our usual secondary (nate) is OOO starting 02:00 UTC and the late-night handover in 3h will have a 1hr overlap gap. plan: set sre-backup as reachable and if we escalate to infra scaling we ring them.

samir: acknowledged. I'll include the overlap note in the incident timeline and flag the SLA window.

luke: immediate mitigation steps I'm doing now:
- pin model to smaller KV profile for 10% of traffic (canary)
- increase autoscale min replicas for pool us-east-1 by +2
- flush prefix cache on nodes showing errors

maya (oncall): if anyone needs quick commands, use the service tool:

```
# scale pool
redwoodctl pool scale --region us-east-1 --pool inference-a100 --min 6
# pin model variant for canary
redwoodctl deployment update --model my-model:v2-small-kv --selector canary=1
# flush cache on node
ssh ubuntu@svc-serve-12 'sudo /usr/local/bin/kvctl flush --prefix "session:"'
```

luke: ran cache flush on svc-serve-12 and svc-serve-14. saw immediate drop in eviction_count on those nodes after 30s. p95 down from 320 -> 190. will continue to monitor.

ops-bot: ACTION LOG: driver=luke, comms=samir, backup=sre-backup, incident=INC-2026-1345 (assigned at 1760509876)

samir: posted customer-facing note in #incident-notices and scheduled follow-up at +30m. linked to status page.

maya (oncall): finalizing assignments for the shift change: driver = luke, comms = samir, backup = maya (overnight fallback) + sre-backup for infra escalation. coverage gap noted 02:00-03:00 UTC, escalations then go to sre-backup.

luke: I'll keep updates in this thread every 10m until p99 < 600ms for 2 consecutive cycles. next update in 8m. :thumbsup:

samir: copying product-safety and customer-success in updates. :white_check_mark:

maya (oncall): thanks team. handing the bridge to @luke as driver. If anything changes before handover to nightshift, we'll reassign.

sre-backup: standing by — if you hit scaling limits or consistent OOMs, escalate and I'll coordinate quota bump with infra.

maya (oncall): thread summary for handoff record: driver=luke, comms=samir, runbook used=inference-cache-pressure, mitigations=cache flush + canary pin + +2 replicas, coverage gap 02:00-03:00 UTC -> escalate to sre-backup. saved to incident timeline.
